bias.en: Uptrend pausing · slipped under $572, above the 30-day
bias.zh: 上升趋势暂歇 · 跌破 $572，仍在 30 日均线上方

read.en: Berkshire B edged down 0.4% on Nov 20 to $570.00, trading $566.52–576.89. It is below the 5-day ($579.3, falling) and 10-day ($582.6, rising), and above the 30-day ($556.7), 100-day ($520.4) and 200-day ($502.6), all rising. MACD has been below its signal since Nov 18, above zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 18 ($595.21), and RSI is 56.6, down from 80.9 five sessions ago.
read.zh: 伯克希尔 B 股 11月20日微跌 0.4%，收于 $570.00，盘中区间 $566.52–576.89。股价位于 5 日（$579.3，下行）和 10 日均线（$582.6，上行）下方，在 30 日（$556.7）、100 日（$520.4）和 200 日均线（$502.6）上方，三者均在上行。MACD 自 11月18日起位于信号线下方，在零轴上方，柱状图放大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月18日起看空（$595.21），RSI 为 56.6，五个交易日前为 80.9。

read.en: The close slipped under the $571–572 support (Nov 5 and 6 closes), now resistance, but held above the Nov 19 low ($565.60). Resistance is $572–577 (Nov 20 high), then $579–583.7 (5- and 10-day) and $589–597 (52-week high). Support is $562.5–566.5 (Nov 9, 19 and 20 lows), then $556.7–557 (30-day, Nov 3 close) and $550. A close above $577 would target $579–583.7; below $562.5, $556.7.

r.en: Nov 5 close $572.33, lost; Nov 9 close $575.25; Nov 20 high $576.89
